Mumbai court gives life sentences to 44 Somali pirates

A special court in Mumbai has sentenced 44 Somali pirates to life imprisonment. The court convicted them in connection with the hijacking of the MV Ruen. The Indian Navy was also commended for its swift response in the operation.
